# Guagua Tools

> A free, lightweight collection of browser tools for developers, AI agent users, and creators.

- Home: https://guagua-alvin.top/
- Privacy: https://guagua-alvin.top/privacy
- MCP tools collection: https://guagua-alvin.top/mcp-tools
- AI agent tools collection: https://guagua-alvin.top/ai-agent-tools
- Web utilities collection: https://guagua-alvin.top/web-utilities
- PrintSpec Lab: https://printspeclab.guagua-alvin.top/
- MCP Config Lab: https://mcp.guagua-alvin.top/
- MCP Config Guard: https://mcpcheck.guagua-alvin.top/
- MCP OAuth Lab: https://mcpoauth.guagua-alvin.top/
- AgentFile Check: https://agentslint.guagua-alvin.top/
- Agent Skill Guard: https://skillguard.guagua-alvin.top/
- RegistryReady: https://mcpregistry.guagua-alvin.top/
- CrawlerPolicy: https://aipolicy.guagua-alvin.top/
- ARD Catalog Lab: https://ard.guagua-alvin.top/
- A2UI Stream Lab: https://a2ui.guagua-alvin.top/
- AG-UI Event Lab: https://agui.guagua-alvin.top/
- MCP App Ready: https://mcpapps.guagua-alvin.top/
- MCP Task Trace: https://mcptasks.guagua-alvin.top/

The directory requires no account. Individual tools describe their own local-processing and privacy boundaries.
